invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null List, as both branches return a constructed List (deduplicatedKeys or keys).
The method ensures that the returned List<HoodieKey> is deduplicated, so converting it to a HashSet should not reduce the number of elements.
The return type is always a List<HoodieKey>.
In many distributed scenarios, parallelism is expected to be at least 1.
Lists created from keys or populated via forEach do not insert null elements, assuming keys itself does not contain nulls.
